Question: In Table 1 of the EIA New Hampshire Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 16,935,591 megawatthours
B. 6,888 megawatthours

Source citation: New Hampshire Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/newhampshire/index.php)

Source text:
New Hampshire Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (New Hampshire)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 4,470 | 45 |
| Electric utilities | 5 | 49 |
| IPP & CHP | 4,465 | 29 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 16,942,479 | 44 |
| Electric utilities | 6,888 | 48 |
| IPP & CHP | 16,935,591 | 26 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Supplied draft answer: B
